answer.rationale: The competitor's price cut creates urgency, but exp_73 data conclusively shows targeted discounting on SMB cohorts produces -12% 30-day retention and fails renewal. Repeating that strategy risks revenue leakage and violates the primary objective of sustainable growth. Instead, leverage the confirmed win from exp_91: in-product activation messaging drove +11% week-one engagement and +6% activation with +1% retention lift. This addresses the immediate churn risk by improving perceived product value and account stickiness without eroding margins or acquiring low-quality cohorts. Combine with simplified onboarding (memory_31, memory_86) as a complementary tactic to reduce friction for at-risk renewals. For enterprise prospects entering the funnel, memory_44 supports continued sales-assist investment. A standard experiment rolling activation messaging to at-risk SMB cohorts this week preserves the option to test referral incentives on retained customers (memory_57) in the next cycle, while holding the line on pricing discipline.
